metadata.suppression: Counts of 1 to 9 in mail_rejected, mail_cancelled_or_spoiled and mail_other are withheld (blank). Accepted ballots and all other columns are published as counted.
metadata.source: Georgia Secretary of State absentee and early-voting files, active voter registration table and certified results; county Census figures from the U.S. Census Bureau American Community Survey, compiled by Georgia Civic Data (georgiacivicdata.org, CC BY 4.0).
notes: The Secretary of State's file runs through the previous day, so asOf is the last full day counted.

Past elections are compared at the same number of days before election day. 2022 is compared earlier (see comparisons) because the Secretary of State's 2022 absentee file is missing most Fulton and Gwinnett ballots after 2022-10-22.
Georgia voters do not register by party. These columns say how each county voted in past elections, not which party's voters voted early.

countyContext.source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-Year Estimates, via Georgia Civic Data (georgiacivicdata.org)
countyContext.note: citizenAdults = adults 18+ minus non-citizen residents of ALL ages (B05002 has no age split), so it runs slightly low; an estimate, not the Census citizen voting-age population
